title: Real or AI?
hook: This guy gets chased, splashed and scared by living drawings
caption:
Pencil doodles that fight back: a monster, a fish, a paper airplane, all living on the page.

Want to make a scene like this with AI? The image prompt + video prompt are in the comments 👇 (make the image first, then animate it with an image-to-video tool).

Source: @Arzoo12sh on X
Follow @aiplaybooks.daily for daily AI tips & news

#AIvideo #AIart #promptengineering #AItools #ViralVideo
comments:
Step 1 - image prompt (via @Arzoo12sh):

Create a highly detailed surreal 3D photorealistic scene on a large white spiral notebook lying on a wooden table. The notebook contains realistic pencil sketches that come alive in three-dimensional form. Show several identical young men interacting with the drawings: one man is scared of a giant cartoon monster, another is drawing with an enormous pencil, one is standing in front of a fan while papers fly around, another is sitting on a giant paper airplane, one is fishing for a tiny drawn fish, another is stirring a giant frightened coffee cup, one is relaxing under a beach umbrella with a drink, and another is lifting a large paper sheet revealing tiny cartoon characters underneath. Keep the pencil drawings black-and-white while the real human figures remain photorealistic and naturally integrated into the notebook. Strong depth, realistic shadows, detailed pencil texture, cinematic lighting, whimsical fantasy, impossible perspective, highly realistic, vertical 9:16 composition.

Step 2 - video prompt (via @Arzoo12sh):

Create a cinematic surreal animation starting with a large white spiral notebook covered with detailed pencil drawings on a wooden table. The pencil drawings magically come to life and interact with photorealistic human characters. Show smooth dynamic movements: a giant pencil is used for drawing, a cartoon monster reacts to a frightened man, a powerful fan blows loose paper sheets through the scene, a man rides a giant paper airplane, another man fishes for a tiny cartoon fish, a giant coffee cup reacts with a surprised face while being stirred, a man relaxes under a beach umbrella with music playing nearby, and another man lifts a giant paper sheet revealing tiny cartoon characters underneath. Use realistic camera movement, close-ups, smooth transitions between each scene, natural human motion, realistic shadows, detailed pencil textures, cinematic depth of field, playful surreal comedy, seamless integration between 2D pencil sketches and 3D real people, high-quality photorealistic AI video, vertical 9:16.
checked: Searched for the creator/technique ("KM Montaser", "drawing comes to life") on 2026-09-25 — found no official source confirming this specific clip was made with Gemini, Grok, or GPT video tools; this genre of real-actor-plus-sketch videos predates current AI video generators, so the tool claim in the source post is treated as unverified and not repeated as fact.
